author: Simon Martinelli
html:
Spring Boot can create images without a Dockerfile:

mvn spring-boot:build-image

author: Sumith Puri
html:
Thanks to Simon Martinelli for pointing this out! This one mentioned here by Simon still requires a Docker Daemon to be available. Please read further about this over here: https://www.baeldung.com/spring-boot-docker-images

Also, Jib by (Google Container Tools) is the one that doesn’t need a Docker Daemon. [Read Here] : https://medium.com/swlh/build-a-docker-image-using-maven-and-spring-boot-58147045a400
